description.text:
The third Expansion Sheet series, the green one, released on 24 November 1998: 53 cards on eighteen numbered sheets. Each sheet holds three cards and one special card with a non-standard back, most of them joke cards, extra game rules or theme deck ideas.

Japan's Expansion Sheets, which collectors call the Vending Series, were sold from vending machines as random sheets of glossy cards to peel off. Each series is split into six places in Kanto, and every numbered sheet always holds the same cards, which match its place. The green sheets also announced the Evolution by Mail campaign: sending in Kadabra, Machoke, Graveler, Haunter or Omanyte with the Bill's PC card, from 24 November 1998 until 30 April 1999, brought back its evolved form as a holofoil promo, the way those Pokémon evolve by trading in the games. One of its cards, Mewtwo, carries art from a CoroCoro Comic illustration contest, like three on the blue sheet, and some of the cards later came out in English as Wizards Black Star Promos through the 2001-2002 Pokémon League.
